english.title: Attempt to sexually assault by penetration a male aged 13 or over
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) attempted to sexually penetrate the anus of a

(A)_[boy aged13]_
(B)_[boy aged14]_
(C)_[boy aged15]_
(D)_[man aged 16 or over]_

with

(E)_[a part of your body, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PART..),]_
(F)_[a thing, namely **(..SPECIFY THE THING..),]_
(G)_[a part of your body and a thing, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PART AND THING..),]_

with intent to do so when he did not consent and you did not reasonably believe that he was consenting
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) of the Criminal Attempts Act 1981.

investigatoraction.description: Attracts liability for entry on sex offenders register
Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) An act done by a person in a country or territory outside the United Kingdom which, constituted an offence under the law in force in that country or territory, and would constitute a sexual offence to which this section applies if it had been done in England and Wales or in Northern Ireland, constitutes that sexual offence under the law of that part of the United Kingdom, and provided that person was on 01/09/1997, or who has since become a British citizen or resident in the United Kingdom he/she may have proceedings brought against them in the United Kingdom. (section 72).A person guilty of this offence is subject to the notification and orders requirements as provided by Part 2 of this Act which commences at section 80. (Schedule 3 paragraph 17).
(ii) A person guilty of this offence is subject to the notification and orders requirements as provided by Part 2 of this Act which commences at section 80. (Schedule 3 paragraph 17).
(iii) IMPORTANT - carefully check an offender's previous convictions. Provisions under sections 224 to 235 of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 may mean that s/he is liable to receive a longer sentence if certain conditions apply.
(iv) Victim's age should be proved by reference to Birth Certificate where possible.

other.penalty:
Indictable only - Life imprisonment

See Note (iv) above re mandatory life sentence
